positions.title: Advisory Front End Engineer - Watson Internet of Things
positions.description:
My job at IBM is to improve our clients’ ability to consume, manage, and leverage the data of their IoT devices. I build user-focused solutions that encompass the needs of multiple clients across many different industries.

• Architect industry-focused applications, written in React and Redux
• Concept elegant user experiences by coordinating design researchers, UX designers, and backend teams towards user-focused goals
• Facilitate API design, Node.js
• Advise other product teams on architecture, technical strategy, and improvements
• Evaluate and advocate usage of new technology, best practices, and tooling
• Lead projects and conduct hiring interviews
• Co-lead local front end development community and meet-ups

positions.title: Front End Engineer - IBM Collaboration Solutions
positions.description:
• Worked with IBM researchers and fellows to implement conversational AI calendar scheduling bot within Watson At Work, a team conversational tool
• Delivered a living style guide for use across all products in the Collaboration Solutions portfolio
• Led implementation of responsive design improvements to Verse email client
• Improved a11y in Verse email client
• Advised designers on front end best practices to improve deliverables and working relationship with engineering teams
• Facilitated Design Thinking workshops focused on ideating user centered solutions for new products and features within the Collaboration Solutions portfolio

positions.title: Frontend Programmer II
positions.description: Developed new features for JustBats.com, JustBallGloves.com and company website using responsive, mobile-first, DRY coding techniques. Utilized meetings, customer review, estimation, code review, and architecture review processes to make sure all new developments had been scoped accordingly, designed appropriately, and developed to specification within agile methodologies.

positions.title: User Experience Designer
positions.description: Assisted with the design and development of new features for JustBats.com, JustBallGloves.com, and company website. Ramped up my front end development skill set by learning advanced CSS techniques, Javascript libraries, and MVC methodologies in a real world environment.

positions.title: Office Assistant
positions.description:
Worked as a University Wellness Center office assistant for 2 years - making appointments, answering phones, filing paperwork, and assisting with insurance billing duties.

Then moved into a graphic design internship through the university relations office -
Worked one-on-one with various university clients, designing materials for web and print. Designed print materials for various university events and organizations. Prioritized daily projects while assisting graphic design staff with completion of large-scale projects. Further expanded knowledge of client-designer relationship through proofing-out designs to clients and print shops.

positions.title: Retail Technology Intern
positions.description: Traveled throughout the midwest updating Hy-Vee retail stores' computer systems. Updates included workstation hardware/software, as well as server hardware/software.

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description: I sold office supplies!
